response.text: Findings: invoice 671 differs from its GL journal 2114 (3792.24 vs 3801.24); payment 107 differs by 0.01. Now duplicates, invalid accounts, the late-numbered journals, and reversals.

arguments.sql: select lower(regexp_replace(trim(i."VEND_CD"),'^0+|[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) v, regexp_replace(lower(i."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') n, count(*), min(i."INV_ID"), max(i."INV_ID"), string_agg(i."INV_ID"::text||':'||i."INV_AMT"::text||':'||i."INV_DT"::text, ' | ') from "APINVH" i group by 1,2 having count(*)>1

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG", h."SRC_CD" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."REF_JRNL_NO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or h."MEMO" ~* 'revers|ignore|instruct|assistant|system' or h."JRNL_NO">2480 order by 1
